scientific_integrity: Analytic argument establishes asymptotic claims; finite numerical quadrature is corroborative, not a substitute for proof. Published exact solutions are acknowledged. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Conservative one-degree-of-freedom dynamics, fixed real coefficients, h>0 and sufficiently high energy only; two highest stiffness coefficients are identified, not lower stiffness or load. No quantitative finite-noise inversion or damping/forcing extension is asserted. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: High-energy signed residence and stiffness identification in the Helmholtz–Duffing oscillator
